text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this hot spring is...! It's completely 
different from the 'Legendary Hidden Hot 
Spring' I found in 'Yufumi'!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
I thought digging here would let us pipe 
the hot spring source efficiently into 
town, but looks like we were a bit off.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
However, this is an unexpected treasure! 
The spring's water seems great for 
recovering from fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"The 'Legendary Secret Hot Spring' isn't 
gonna be easy, huh. Fine by me, bring it 
on!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like the excavation site for the 
"Legendary Secret Hot Spring" is even 
deeper in the mountains. Let's give it one 
more push toward the ultimate hot spring!
